evidence.title: GitHub - SikandarJODD/animations: Svelte 5 Animations includes Magic UI, Spell UI build using Tailwind CSS & Motion SV · GitHub

name: Svelte Animations
summary: Animated Svelte 5 component library: 50+ free, open-source effects ported from Magic UI, Spell UI and Fancy Components.
description: Copy-paste animation components and effects for Svelte 5, built with motion-sv and Tailwind CSS and distributed through the shadcn-svelte registry. The set ports Magic UI (57 components), Spell UI (21) and Fancy Components (10): animated backgrounds, text effects, shiny and ripple buttons, card effects, cursors, a globe, icon cloud, marquee, timeline and progress.
contains: 50+ animated components and effects (67 shadcn registry items measured)
ports: Magic UI 57, Spell UI 21, Fancy Components 10 (per repo README)
animated backgrounds, text effects, buttons, cards, cursors, globe, icon cloud, marquee
built with motion-sv and Tailwind CSS
copy-paste source plus CLI install from the shadcn-svelte registry
free and open source, MIT licensed
